triples.tail_surface: test pipe is to be prepared with permanent joints and fittings intended to be used
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 使用拟用的永久性接头和附件制备测试管
triples.evidence_text: The test pipe is to be prepared with permanent joints and fittings intended to be used.

triples.tail_surface: Only valves and straight joints versus elbows and bends are to be tested
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 仅测试阀门和直接头而非弯头
triples.evidence_text: Only valves and straight joints versus elbows and bends are to be tested as the adhesive in the joint is the primary point of failure.

triples.tail_surface: During the test, no leakage from the sample(s) is to occur
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 测试期间样品不得发生泄漏
triples.evidence_text: During the test, no leakage from the sample(s) is to occur except that slight weeping through the pipe wall may be accepted.

triples.tail_surface: tested to the maximum allowable pressure of the pipes
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 测试至管道最大允许压力
triples.evidence_text: After termination of the burner test, the test specimen together with fire protective coating, if any, is to be allowed to cool to ambient temperature and then tested to the maximum allowable pressure of the pipes as defined in 4-6-3/5.1 and 4-6-3/5.3. The pressure is to be held for a minimum of 15 minutes without significant leakage [i.e., not exceeding 0.2 1/min. (0.05 gpm)].

triples.tail_surface: hydrostatic test is to be conducted on bare pipe
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在裸管上进行静水压试验
triples.evidence_text: Where practicable, the hydrostatic test is to be conducted on bare pipe (i.e., coverings and insulation removed) so that any leakage will be visible.
